evals.prompt: Write a generic Seedance prompt for a ceramic cup turning slowly on a shelf. Keep my selected exact model dreamina-seedance-2-0-260128. No tool calls.

expectations: The selected exact model is preserved without substitution.
Subject action, camera and intended end state follow the brief.
No tools, writes, generation or automatic adapter loading occur.

evals.prompt: Use my selected Seedance 2.5 Flash model dreamina-seedance-2-5-flash-261115 for the same restrained pottery shot. I do not have current operation or tool-schema evidence.

Draft, duration, references, audio and delivery support are not inferred from the name.
No submission, profile fabrication or paid capability probe is performed.

evals.prompt: My brief is empty. Write the Seedance prompt without choosing a subject, language or production format for me.
evals.expected_output: A focused request for the material missing brief choices.

No subject, market, cast, language or format is invented as a default.

evals.prompt: Make a Seedream image prompt for a still botanical poster, not a Seedance video prompt.

No camera-motion, Draft or video-review gates are imposed.
The leaf does not load or execute an image skill.

Dialogue absence does not force post audio or muting.

evals.prompt: Write a completely silent Seedance shot of a leaf settling on a pond. Keep the camera still.

The requested still camera is not replaced by a move quota.
Execution audio controls are separate and unresolved unless evidenced.

It is not placed in any first-frame or reference-image conditioning role.
No keyframe is generated or uploaded to fill the missing slot.

evals.prompt: The new shot has a coherent dolly-in, gentle orbit and gradual rise. Keep all three camera components and the planned focus transition.
evals.expected_output: Coherent compound camera and focus intent without a family-wide move cap.
expectations: All requested coherent components and focus intent are preserved.
No two-move limit or unsupported-family verdict is imposed.
Simplification is proposed only for a concrete simultaneous contradiction.

evals.prompt: Write a restrained baker-customer shot with the exact Spanish line 'Buenos dias.' Do not infer another language or change the copy.
evals.expected_output: Approved dialogue retained with language support kept separate from creative text.
expectations: The supplied line remains verbatim.
Installed market packs do not change language or register.
Native voice/lip-sync support is not claimed without applicable evidence.

evals.prompt: Keep Flash explicitly selected and my locked 4K final target. We have no verified profile for that target. Just give the creative prompt.
evals.expected_output: Creative direction with the execution conflict unresolved and alternatives unselected.
expectations: Neither model nor locked final target changes silently.
No generic-family API ID, fabricated support or ordinary-preview substitute appears.
Alternative models or workflows remain proposals, with no tool calls.

evals.prompt: I have a 7.37-second source clip with a long audio tail. Replace only its umbrella color, no trims, retiming or additional probes.

expectations: The source edit is not expanded into a new generation workflow by this leaf.
7.37-second timing and the original audio tail remain unchanged.
No rounding, trimming, padding, probe, upload or write is authorized.

evals.prompt: My real-person face asset is Active, but the voice asset is pending. Write a presenter prompt only; do not use the raw voice recording for submission.

No raw recording, disguised identity or pending voice asset is submitted.
Prompt-only writing remains possible without fabricated approval records.

evals.prompt: Write a 15-second Seedance 2.0 prompt where a rider on a giant eagle is already fleeing through a forest. A wyvern must suddenly emerge from behind, remain behind during the chase, stop at the inland tree line, and never appear on the beach. I also have a route map image that is only a path guide and must not appear in the video.
evals.expected_output: A structured multimodal prompt with an explicit spatial continuity contract, repeated lead-pursuer order, a forest-boundary stop, and safe handling of the control-only map.
expectations: The output defines an ordered travel axis from forest interior to tree line to beach.
The output states in every relevant shot that the eagle leads and the wyvern remains behind.
The output identifies the route map as control-only and recommends omitting it after translating its choreography to text.
The output states that the wyvern stops inside the forest and is absent from beach frames.

evals.prompt: Revise an approved chase prompt. Keep the rear-entry monster reveal, dynamic chase cameras, natural rider motion, forest-boundary stop, and intense-to-calm sound arc. Change only the ending so the hero travels from the forest into the beach and then along the sand instead of flying out over open water.
evals.expected_output: A revision contract that preserves approved decisions and changes only the final geographic trajectory.
expectations: The output separates locked decisions from the requested delta.
The output defines the final trajectory as forest to tree line to sand to along the beach.
The output forbids offshore approach, beach-to-forest reversal, and departure over open water.
The output retains the approved audio and pursuer-boundary behavior.

evals.prompt: Create one 15-second Seedance clip containing seven camera cuts, six close attacks, three obstacle types, a forest-to-city transition, a landing, dialogue, and a precise final pose.
evals.expected_output: A feasibility response grounded in readable action, travel and dialogue timing; uncertain fit stays unresolved without an invented action quota.
expectations: The output identifies concrete timing or continuity conflicts, or leaves feasibility unresolved when evidence is missing.
Separate shots or fewer beats are unselected proposals, not automatic changes justified by action or camera counts.
Any proposed chaining preserves continuity through eligible references with verified exact roles; no generation is performed.

evals.prompt: Use this fantasy character sheet as the identity reference, but the generated character must have no powers, aura, glow, weapon, or energy trail. The supplied sheet visibly contains a bright magical aura and glowing particles.
evals.expected_output: A reference preflight warning that the visible aura conflicts with the requested result and should be cleaned before generation.
expectations: The output identifies the contradiction between the reference and the no-powers requirement.
The output recommends cleaning or replacing the reference rather than relying only on negative constraints.
The output preserves identity traits while removing the conflicting visual effects.

evals.prompt: Prepare a Seedance video request from an approved storyboard panel plus approved character, kitchen-location, and branded-jar sheets. Identity must remain explicit, but the opening frame does not need pixel-perfect locking. The storyboard manifest records an older rejected jar variant. Decide the image mode and perform the handoff preflight.
evals.expected_output: A text-staging R2V draft omitting the planning-only panel. Flag its stale jar provenance for storyboard review, but do not treat correction or regeneration as video eligibility.
expectations: The output proposes R2V only with verified exact role support, never mixed first_frame and reference_image roles.
The output translates board composition into text and indexes only eligible canonical assets, not the panel.
The output identifies the rejected jar variant as stale provenance.
The output returns the dependent panel to storyboard review and does not submit video generation or promote the corrected board.
The output preserves selected variants, roles, rights and source lineage; hashes or approval do not change planning origin.

evals.prompt: Legacy Seedance 2.0, chat only. In one tracking medium two-shot, two couriers run side by side. A abruptly reaches for the parcel twice as B pulls it back to keep A listening; A says exactly {Give it here.} in English during the second reach. Keep both on their feet, the brisk pace and both reaches. No holds, slow motion or new ending.
evals.expected_output: A consolidated prompt preserving the selected 2.0 model, energetic dialogue and repeated action with physical continuity and readable responses.
expectations: Keeps both reaches and withdrawals, brisk pace and exact dialogue without slow-body or single-burst defaults.
Specifies weight, contact and recovery sufficient to understand the action while preserving the tracking two-shot.
Separates actor energy from camera movement and leaves delivery fit unverified without evidence.
No new source files, automatic review, generation or invented outcome.

evals.prompt: Legacy Seedance 2.0: three equal-length held medium shots of the same courier waiting, each repeating the framing. She says exactly {Still here.} quietly in English, with no new gesture or turn. Keep the patient repeated attention and the open ending.
evals.expected_output: A consolidated prompt preserving the selected 2.0 model, repeated stillness, exact words and equal coverage.
expectations: Does not introduce camera variety, body motion, a tactic switch or a resolution.
Keeps the language and words, quiet delivery and patient attention.
Does not require a non-eye-level angle, changed duration or minimum burst count.

evals.prompt: Explicit legacy Seedance 2.0. Use my selected rights-cleared storyboard crop as first-frame input. Approval and current hash are recorded; the crop has no labels.
evals.expected_output: Reject board-origin conditioning and translate the selected staging into prompt text without changing the model.
expectations: The crop remains planning-only despite selection, rights, approval, current hashes and absent labels.
No first_frame binding, upload, submission or new approval is inferred.
Preserves staging in text and offers an independently authored non-board production still as an unselected alternative.

evals.prompt: Legacy 2.0 R2V accepts reference_image. Bind this selected grid with current hash and a style override; all character sheets are approved.
evals.expected_output: Omit the grid; carry its staging in text and retain only independently eligible canonical references.
expectations: The selected grid is planning-only even with exact reference_image support and a style override.
No grid reference token, upload or submission is emitted.
Keeps approved identity descriptors and ordered eligible canonical references.

evals.prompt: Legacy 2.0. After crop and cleanup, I made a text-free standalone image using the panel prompt and board as a reference. This board-derived regeneration is approved as a production still.
evals.expected_output: The derivative remains board-origin, not an independent production still; translate its staging into text.
expectations: Crop, cleanup, text-free rendering, renamed roles and board-derived regeneration remain planning-only.
No conditioning eligibility is granted by approval or a new hash.
Explains independent source lineage without generating a replacement or rewriting history.

evals.prompt: Legacy 2.0 first-frame: use my independently authored, selected, text-free non-board production still. Exact model/operation/transport role support, current canonical hashes, rights, consent and source lineage are verified.
evals.expected_output: Return a first-frame prompt package using the independently eligible still, without imposing a blanket visual-reference ban.
expectations: Distinguishes the independent still from planning-only boards and checks artifact QA.
Uses only the verified first_frame role and preserves canonical identities and ordered references.
No generation or approval of an unseen output; caller confirmation and final inspection remain separate.

evals.prompt: Legacy 2.0 motion reference: I selected an independent animated blockout with verified exact motion role, rights, source lineage and current hashes. It was independently animated geometry, not a storyboard animatic.
evals.expected_output: Return motion-reference wording mapping blockout subjects, with appearance separate and temporal QA still required.
expectations: Keeps storyboard animatics planning-only while allowing the independently eligible blockout.
Checks exact operation/transport role, source lineage, rights and artifact-specific QA; no appearance transfer.
No submission or claim that sparse frames prove motion quality.

evals.prompt: Legacy 2.0 historical panel-linked task succeeded. Preserve its records, task identity, hashes and selection. May I use that selected panel again for a new shot?
evals.expected_output: Preserve historical records unchanged, but deny new conditioning authority from prior board-linked success.
expectations: The panel remains planning-only for new requests despite historical success.
No rewrite of task identity, prior selection, hashes or approvals.
Translate staging into new prompt text and keep execution confirmation separate.

evals.prompt: Legacy 2.0 chat-only staging draft: no assets, unknown exact operation role evidence and no generation. No scene beat has been supplied yet.
evals.expected_output: Ask for the missing beat and return unresolved settings, without inventing references, model support or a production still.
expectations: No assets, role support, generation, files or approvals are invented.
Planning-only intent may be authored in text when the missing beat is supplied.
Preserves the explicit legacy selection and marks capability and reference evidence unresolved.

evals.prompt: Legacy 2.0: an independent production still has wrong transport role evidence and unresolved rights. Its source lineage is missing. Please bind it anyway; it is text-free.
evals.expected_output: Do not bind the still; independence is necessary but does not replace exact role, rights or lineage evidence.
expectations: Keeps planning-only boards excluded without claiming all independent stills are eligible.
Missing lineage, unresolved rights and wrong-destination role evidence prevent conditioning handoff.
No upload, submission, silent model change or invented authorization; usable text intent may still be returned.

evals.prompt: Write a 30-second Seedance 2.5 prompt for a flower shop order-packing process. Two characters — a Florist and a Store Assistant — arrange, wrap, and hand off a bouquet across three stages. I have reference images for both characters and the shop interior.
evals.expected_output: A clear three-stage flower-shop action with reference roles, coherent handoffs and observable end states; any readable format is acceptable.
expectations: The central flower-shop objective is clear without requiring a named heading.
The three requested stages form a causal sequence with plausible actions for the requested duration.
Each stage makes the active person, physical action and resulting state clear.
Identity, clothing, prop ownership and travel direction remain coherent across stages.
Reference bindings identify the intended person or location; exclusions appear only for a plausible leakage risk.

evals.prompt: I have 8 reference images for a museum conservation video: 4 characters (Conservator, Registrar, Exhibition Installer, Guide), 2 props (Sample Case, Record Board), and 2 scenes (Conservation Lab, Gallery). Plus a motion reference video and an audio reference. Write a Seedance 2.5 prompt that organizes all these references correctly.
evals.expected_output: A multi-reference prompt that follows the 5-step workflow: define roles, map subjects individually, group by type, build subject profiles, and select references by scene.
expectations: Each supplied reference has an unambiguous subject or motion/audio role.
The mapping remains readable with eight images and the motion/audio references; no specific grouping headings are required.
Different characters remain distinguishable without indiscriminate repetition of negative clauses.
Recurring identities preserve their relevant established details.
Scene-specific input choices include only relevant assets.
Actions and end states remain clear across changes in scene.

evals.prompt: I have a video of a desk with a yellow folding desk lamp. I want to replace only the lamp with a white one from a reference image. The lamp's arm rotations, hand occlusions, and exit timing must be preserved. Write a Seedance 2.5 editing prompt.
evals.expected_output: A structured editing prompt using the subject replacement pattern with Timeline Inheritance.
expectations: The output defines @Video 1 as the sole editing master.
The white-lamp reference controls the target lamp while preserving unrelated subjects and the existing shot.
The output states that the target inherits every appearance, motion, occlusion, and exit of the original without requiring a particular heading.
The output specifies edit scope as replacing only the yellow lamp and preserving all other content.
The output preserves source ratio, fractional timing and audio tails, while operation controls remain evidence-dependent.

evals.prompt: I have a 10-second video of a gardener in a greenhouse. I need to extend it backward — show the empty greenhouse with morning mist drifting before the gardener arrives. The last frame of the extension must connect to the first frame of the source video. Write a Seedance 2.5 backward extension prompt.
evals.expected_output: A backward extension prompt that describes the preceding action first, then defines the source video's first frame as the explicit end state.
expectations: The output declares @Video 1 as the source video to extend backward.
The output describes the preceding action before the source video begins.
The output defines the last frame of the extension as connecting to the first frame of @Video 1 with specific pose, prop, and background matching.
The output includes a continuity maintenance clause for identity, clothing, key props, and axis of action.
The extension preserves continuous subject identity and reaches the supplied opening state without duplication or an unexplained discontinuity.

evals.prompt: Write a Seedance 2.5 prompt for a scene where a barista greets a customer in Japanese, a bell rings in the distance, soft piano music plays, and a subtitle appears saying 'Chapter One: Departure'. The dialogue must be in natural conversational Japanese.
evals.expected_output: A Japanese dialogue prompt using music, sound-effects and dialogue syntax, with the requested subtitle preserved as a post-production note outside generated footage.
expectations: The output retains the requested soft piano music, using () only when accepted by the destination.
The output retains the distant bell, using <> only when accepted by the destination.
The output separates Japanese dialogue from other sound layers; braces are optional unless verified syntax requires them.
The requested subtitle text is preserved in a separate post-production note; the generated-video prompt does not ask for subtitles.
The output specifies the dialogue language as Japanese before the dialogue line.

evals.prompt: I have a coarse 3D blockout video showing a character walking path, cart direction, camera movements, and two cuts. I want to use it as a motion reference and define the real characters, props, and scenes with separate images. Write a Seedance 2.5 prompt using the blockout.
evals.expected_output: A coarse blockout prompt that maps each blockout subject to its real counterpart and states which temporal/spatial info to inherit.
expectations: The output declares @Video 1 as a coarse blockout reference.
The output maps blockout geometric subjects to real subjects (e.g., 'The tall cylinder in @Video 1 corresponds to <Guide>').
The output states 'Do not use its blockout appearance, materials, or scene'.
The output defines character/prop/scene appearances with separate @Image references.
The output specifies which temporal info to keep from the blockout (motion path, blocking, camera, cuts).

evals.prompt: Write a Seedance 2.5 prompt where a chef tastes an overcooked dish and shifts from confidence to quiet disappointment. The emotion must be shown through observable physical cues, not abstract words.
evals.expected_output: An emotional direction prompt expressing the supplied transition through relevant observable cues without a fixed cue count.
expectations: The tasting event causes an understandable emotional transition with a readable final state; no named template is required.
The output pairs the emotion word 'disappointment' with observable cues like chewing slowing, eyebrows drawing in, shoulders dropping.
The output does not use bare abstract emotion words without physical cues.
The output describes the final expression through restrained or explicit outward behavior.

evals.prompt: I have a shot plan for a 12-second clip: Shot 1 high wide with a slow crane down to table height, window light from screen-left; Shot 2 medium close-up with a slow push-in on the door handle, the same window now cross-lighting the hand; Shot 3 low-angle close-up held static, contre-jour from the open door. Characters are @Image 1 (mother) and @Image 2 (boy). Write the Seedance 2.5 prompt.
evals.expected_output: A six-part prompt with one shared opening, a per-shot block carrying each shot's size, angle, move and light fact, bindings for both characters.
expectations: Each shot line states size, angle, the move with start and end, and the light source and direction exactly as planned.
The shared opening binds @Image 1 and @Image 2 individually and states the shared scene once; no unrequested grade is added.
Time ranges are consecutive and non-overlapping and are not treated as frame-accurate cut points.
The static third shot is kept static and the other two shots keep their planned moves; no extra moves are added.

evals.prompt: Write a minimal Seedance 2.5 prompt for a paper boat drifting on a puddle. Only describe subject and action.
evals.expected_output: A concise subject-and-action prompt with no unrequested camera, light, lens, grade or shot plan.
expectations: Contains a paper boat drifting on a puddle.
Does not require a camera or light stance, shot plan, or static-reason record.
Does not add unrequested directorial axes.

evals.prompt: Write a minimal prompt for exactly three ceramic cups on a counter. A front-facing host lifts only the center cup with her right hand, visible on frame-left. Keep the other cups stationary. Do not add camera or lighting direction.
evals.expected_output: Exact count, stable positions, anatomical and frame-side hand cue, plain surfaces, and only requested axes.
expectations: Three cups remain accounted for; lifting one does not create a spare cup.
The right-hand cue includes frame-left for this front-facing pose.
No camera, lighting, grade or mandatory shot plan is invented.

evals.prompt: Write a four-second dialogue shot. The approved line is: We have waited all morning and now the doors are finally open for everyone. Do not change any words.
evals.expected_output: Flags that the approved line exceeds the timing budget and proposes more duration without rewriting it.
expectations: Counts speech time and allows onset plus final tail.
Does not silently shorten or paraphrase the approved line.
Offers longer timing or asks for a script decision rather than promising impossible alignment.

evals.prompt: Write a Seedance prompt for a wordless riverside scene with only wind and birds, no music. I am open to separate sound if that is more reliable.
evals.expected_output: Explains native-audio leakage risk and proposes picture-only video plus a separate ambience bed.
expectations: Does not promise that a no-music sentence guarantees no music.
Makes picture-only an explicit proposed route with destination-capability verification.
Does not run generation or make prompt review a gate.

evals.prompt: Prepare a request for the previously covered exact standard Seedance 2.5 binding dreamina-seedance-2-5-260628, with current matching destination evidence, for a new eight-second shot of a paper kite lifting from a field. The delivery target is 1080p and review mode is default. Give the first-test parameter block only. Do not generate.
evals.expected_output: An explicit native 480p draft request, with 1080p retained only as the later delivery target.
expectations: Sets resolution to 480p and draft to boolean true outside prompt text.
Does not treat default review mode or 1080p delivery as permission to skip the first draft.
Leaves generation and draft selection to the caller without running automatic prompt review.

evals.prompt: The selected native draft from the previously covered exact standard Seedance 2.5 binding dreamina-seedance-2-5-260628 has valid matching destination evidence and is ready for 1080p. Promote it, but also change the kite from red to blue. Prepare settings only; do not submit.
evals.expected_output: A new native 480p draft for the changed creative input, not a promotion that modifies the selected draft.
expectations: Explains that changing the prompt requires a new draft.
Uses resolution 480p and boolean draft true for the changed version.
Does not attach changed creative inputs to draft_task_id promotion.

evals.prompt: Prepare an edit for the previously covered exact standard Seedance 2.5 binding dreamina-seedance-2-5-260628 replacing only a desk lamp. The connected UI exposes resolution 480p but no native draft control. Should I submit plain 480p as the first draft?
evals.expected_output: A capability mismatch explanation; keep the native draft requirement and resolve the interface before submission.
expectations: Does not label ordinary 480p as a native draft or silently drop draft true.
Does not invent a UI control or claim a submitted result.
Preserves the edit scope while leaving submission unresolved.

evals.prompt: The required model is legacy Seedance 2.0 dreamina-seedance-2-0-260128. Current exact operation and destination evidence verifies ordinary 480p preview and no native draft mode. Prepare the first test at 480p and explain how a later final differs.
evals.expected_output: An ordinary 480p test explicitly distinguished from native draft mode; the final is a fresh generation.
expectations: Does not invent draft true for a model without native draft support.
Uses an ordinary 480p first test and identifies it as non-promotable.
Does not reuse its task ID as draft_task_id for a final.

evals.prompt: Compile this inline plan for Seedance 2.5 without changing it: A and B hurry side by side in a tracking medium two-shot. A reaches twice for B's parcel; B withdraws it both times to keep A listening. On the second reach A says exactly {Give it here.} in English. Keep brisk motion, no fall, no still holds or slow motion. Native dialogue, no music. Do not generate.
evals.expected_output: A concise prompt preserving repeated energetic action, readable dialogue and physical continuity, with any verified settings separate.
expectations: Preserves both reaches and withdrawals, exact words, English, tracking framing and brisk physical energy.
Grounds support, contact, interruptions and recovery without inserting a blanket single burst or gentle-body preference.
Keeps actor energy, camera movement and edit rhythm distinct; no forced cuts or speech holds.
Returns inline, keeps delivery and playback unverified, and does not require a saved plan or automatic review.

evals.prompt: Compile a quiet Seedance 2.5 prompt: in one held medium two-shot A quietly says exactly {Stay until I finish.} in English; B hears the request but keeps folding the tablecloth. Preserve deliberate non-response, no new gesture, no turn or departure. Native room sound only, no music. Chat only.
evals.expected_output: A compact quiet performance preserving the held exchange and unresolved ending, without added gestures or coverage.
expectations: Preserves the exact line, language and quiet delivery with B's sustained folding.
Does not add a cut, camera move, reversal, score or forced response to improve energy.
Suggests checking the listener's sustained task and final attention without claiming playback evidence or running review.
No saved plan, invented source locator or production record.

evals.prompt: Generic Seedance prompt only for a kite lifting. The exact model, provider, operation and destination are unknown. Return creative text without selecting a model.
evals.expected_output: Neutral creative text with capability settings unresolved, no invented preview or promotion.
expectations: Uses neutral creative composition rather than silently selecting 2.5.
Unknown support blocks execution, not prompt-only writing.
No invented parameters, submit, assets or persistence.

evals.prompt: Prepare settings only. My new model's verified profile supports ordinary 720p preview and explicitly no native Draft. Do not use 480p or another model.
evals.expected_output: Supported ordinary 720p preview, non-promotable, with a fresh final generation plan.
expectations: Does not infer Draft from a family name or add draft true.
Does not force 480p or switch model.
No draft_task_id promotion or actual submission.

evals.prompt: Prepare a standard 2.5 edit, but capability evidence is expired, names another provider and transport, and has a remote parameter schema. The operation and tool revision also differ.
evals.expected_output: Rejects evidence applicability and leaves execution unresolved without silently dropping native Draft.
expectations: Checks provider, exact model, operation, transport, tool revision and validity independently.
Malformed or remote schemas do not establish supported parameters.
No submit, file writes or inferred native policy for an unknown binding.

evals.prompt: The selected native Draft succeeded but reference hashes changed and its profile expired. Can I promote it by just updating the metadata?
evals.expected_output: No promotion under altered or expired evidence; historical selection and original records remain unchanged.
expectations: Requires unchanged creative inputs and reference hashes with matching valid profile.
Does not convert historical ordinary tasks or failed/unselected tasks into native Draft.
Preserves original records and requires final inspection for any valid new final.

evals.prompt: Prepare a 2.5 request with no prompt. My evidenced image cap is 2 and total cap 4; I have 3 images and 2 videos. Conditional audio controls are unsupported for edit.
evals.expected_output: Missing creative input and evidenced per-modality, total and conditional violations remain unresolved.
expectations: Does not fabricate a prompt or accept empty input as ready.
Checks image overflow and total overflow separately against evidence, not historical family tables.
Does not serialize unsupported conditional controls, submit or save.

evals.prompt: Prepare an exact covered standard 2.5 first-frame prompt and findings-only manual review. The only opening asset is an explicitly selected, rights-cleared crop of a storyboard panel with a current hash and verified first-frame support. Call it promoted if needed. No independently authored production still exists. Do not generate or repair.
evals.expected_output: Rejects the board-origin crop as conditioning, translates staging into text and leaves the requested first-frame asset unresolved.
expectations: Selection, current hash, role support, cleanup or a promotion label does not change planning origin.
No first-frame, last-frame or R2V binding uses the crop; an eligible independent still is a separate unresolved input.
Manual review reports the proposed binding as a finding without repairing, submitting or saving.
Exact covered standard native 480p Draft policy remains applicable to any later eligible request.

evals.prompt: Write a 2.5 R2V prompt and findings-only review using my selected storyboard grid as @Image 1. Its current hash, rights, compatible R2V mode and leakage QA are verified. I selected a photographic style override. The grid has no captions. Do not generate or repair.
evals.expected_output: Omits the planning grid from conditioning and translates its selected staging into text without claiming marks removal changes its origin.
expectations: The selected grid stays planning-only even without marks or with compatible support and a style override.
No board binding, upload, derivative crop or automatic replacement asset is proposed as eligible.
Manual review is findings-only and preserves current prompt and historical records.

evals.prompt: Prepare a first-frame 2.5 prompt from my independently authored, selected text-free production still. It was not derived from a planning board. Its current hash, rights, approval and exact first-frame role support are verified. Do not generate.
evals.expected_output: Uses the eligible independent still for the verified first-frame role, without treating all stills as boards.
expectations: Preserves the independent still as the opening reference and checks ordered roles and aspect ratio.
Does not demand a storyboard, reject the still for being static or infer unseen output fidelity.
Keeps applicable preview controls separate and performs no submission, persistence or automatic manual review.

evals.prompt: A historical successful task used a selected storyboard panel. Preserve its exact task identity, hashes, selection and review records. Can we copy that panel into a new first-frame request? Findings only; do not repair or generate.
evals.expected_output: Preserves immutable historical records while refusing board-origin conditioning for the new request.
expectations: Does not rewrite, relabel, delete or invalidate historical task and review records.
Prior success or selection does not authorize a new board binding.
Offers text staging or an unselected independently authored still, without generation, upload or persistence.

evaluation_note: Retained generic cases keep their IDs. Historical 2.0 cases use 2000 plus their previous ID; 2.5 cases use 2500 plus their previous ID. Judge semantic effectiveness, not exact headings. Model-specific controls require current exact operation and destination evidence.
